errors.text_span: 标签包括“程度量级”, “音高”, “频次频”, “尺寸”, “速度”, “相对向性”, “光锐光彩”, “倾向性格”, “负面性价”, “负面情绪”, “正面性格”, “正面情绪”, “中面性态”和“负面性态”
errors.evidence: The list of x-axis labels is highly inaccurate and incomplete. It misreads many labels (e.g., '音高' instead of '声音', '倾向性格' instead of '样态') and omits nine of the twenty-three categories present in the chart.
The description states the vertical axis represents frequency, but the axis has no label, so this is an interpretation rather than a direct description.
The description claims the vertical axis is labeled '程度级别', but the axis has no label at all.

errors.text_span: “程度量级”的柱状图高度约为 28
errors.evidence: The label for this bar is '程度重', not '程度量级'. The value is approximately correct for the bar, but the label is wrong.

errors.text_span: “倾向性格”的柱状图高度约为 67
errors.evidence: The label for the tallest bar is '样态', not '倾向性格'. The value is approximately correct for the bar, but the label is wrong.

errors.text_span: 其他类别柱状图的高度在 10 到 56 之间
errors.evidence: This range is incorrect. Multiple bars are below 10 (e.g., '频次' is approx. 2) and several other bars are above 56 (e.g., '负面状态' is approx. 64, '正面状态' is approx. 60).

errors.text_span: 各柱状图没有特别的视觉强调，例如阴影或轮廓。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the bars have no outlines ('轮廓'), but they are all clearly outlined in black.
